items.question: How do I get my measurements?
items.answer: Four ways: a hands-free body scan where your phone guides you by voice, two photos, a quick estimate from your height, weight and a few questions about your shape, or the numbers from your tailor's book. Only an outline of your body leaves your phone. No photo is uploaded or kept.

items.question: Who sees my details?
items.answer: Your tailor sees your short name, your area and the measurements they need to make your order. Nothing else. When you measure with your phone, only an outline of your body is sent, never a photo.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Ready-to-wear shows a delivery estimate on every product. For made-to-measure and bespoke pieces, your tailor gives you their timeline in the quote, before you pay. If a vendor misses their promised window, our On-Time Promise credits compensation to your wallet.

items.question: Can I talk to the person making my outfit?
items.answer: Yes. Every bespoke order has its own chat with your tailor while it's being made, with your design and measurements right beside the conversation.

items.question: Can I return something?
items.answer: Ready-to-wear items can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Pieces made to your measurements cannot be returned, because they were made for you, but if something is wrong with one you can report a problem from the order. Refunds go to your Qlozet wallet.

items.question: What does it cost to sell on Qlozet?
items.answer: Nothing to join, no monthly fee and no listing fee. Qlozet takes 10% of each sale, itemised on every order. Earnings become available 14 days after the customer pays, and you can withdraw to your bank whenever you like.
